decision.rationale: The Weather Forecast Research Team on the UBC EOAS hostname presents an institutional research team, UBC rooftop observations, research publications and useful public descriptions of forecasting applications. It is neither a personal site nor an Okanagan-exclusive service. Homepage sections support research as the main purpose, with testimonials as stories and contact information as support. The Special Projects and Opportunities label describes forecasting applications rather than student recruitment or funding.
